themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards surge
themes_detail.summary: East Flatbush experienced 4 electrical complaints THIS WEEK, a 3100% spike from the 8-week baseline average of 0.1 complaints per week (z-score: 11.72), signaling a potential sudden infrastructure failure or safety hazard affecting multiple properties.
evidence: 4 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 11.72 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Electrical hazards pose fire and electrocution risks to residents
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents and Con Edison about root cause of simultaneous electrical failures
Investigate whether aging electrical infrastructure in East Flatbush (built early 20th century) is deteriorating faster than utility maintenance cycles

themes_detail.label: Street condition deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints surged to 38 THIS WEEK—a 316% increase from the 8-week average of 9.1 per week (z-score: 5.42)—suggesting accelerating pavement failure or pothole formation across the district.
evidence: 38 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 9.1 weekly average
Aligns with damaged tree complaints (10 THIS WEEK, +567%), suggesting possible weather event or infrastructure stress
reporting_angles: Canvass streets in high-complaint areas to document and photograph specific potholes, then compare with 311 data density maps
Ask NYC DOT why street repairs lag so far behind complaints; request data on repair timelines in this district vs. citywide average

themes_detail.label: Damaged tree spike
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints reached 10 THIS WEEK, a 567% increase from the 1.5 weekly average (z-score: 5.67), potentially indicating storm damage, disease outbreak, or systematic neglect across the district's urban canopy.
evidence: 10 damaged tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average
Dead/dying tree complaints also spiked last week (5 complaints vs. 0.2 average, z-score: 10.97), showing sustained tree health crisis
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Parks Department about disease or pest outbreaks affecting East Flatbush trees; request tree audit data
Investigate whether recent weather events (wind, freeze) caused this spike or if it reveals chronic tree maintenance gaps

themes_detail.label: Street cleanliness crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints jumped to 14 LAST WEEK (918% above the 1.4 weekly average, z-score: 4.69) and dirty condition complaints reached 48 LAST WEEK (269% above the 13.0 weekly average, z-score: 4.95), indicating a sanitation service collapse or resource shortage.
evidence: 14 street sweeping complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (918% spike, z-score: 4.69)
48 dirty condition complaints LAST WEEK vs. 13.0 weekly average (269% spike, z-score: 4.95)
Two converging sanitation metrics suggest widespread service failure
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Sanitation to ask about staffing, equipment breakdowns, or route changes in East Flatbush last week
Document street cleanliness visually across district and compare to nearby neighborhoods to isolate whether this is localized or citywide

themes_detail.label: Elevator system failures
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints hit 135 THREE WEEKS AGO—a 503% spike from the 22.4 weekly average (z-score: 9.14)—with no recent data showing recovery, suggesting unresolved maintenance backlogs in residential buildings across the district.
evidence: 135 elevator complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 22.4 weekly average (503% spike, z-score: 9.14)
No more recent spike data indicates problem may have persisted or receded; needs verification of current status
Elevator failures directly impact elderly and disabled residents in multi-family buildings
reporting_angles: Interview residents in buildings with chronic elevator complaints; identify whether landlords are stalling repairs or equipment is aging out
Investigate Department of Housing Preservation and Development enforcement: how many elevator violations were issued in East Flatbush in past 90 days and what was resolution time?
